caption: A small air pump runs with its tube in a glass of soapy water, and bubbles rise and pile up in a foam at the top of the glass.

sa.check: An air pump's tube sits in a glass of soapy water.
Foam piles up at the top of the glass.
The bubbles come first and the foam builds after.

pc.expect: Bubbles form at the tube tip and rise to the surface, and none sink.
pc.fail: Bubbles sink; or hang mid-water; or form at the surface and go down.

pc.expect: The foam builds while the pump runs as a mass of small bubbles and spills over the rim if it gets tall.
pc.fail: Bubbles pop instantly leaving no foam; or the foam is a rigid dome; or the foam grows while the pump is off.

pc.expect: The foam only grows while pumping.
pc.fail: It shrinks while pumping; or it is there before pumping; or it jumps.

pc.expect: The tube and the glass stay put.
pc.fail: The glass slides; or the tube whips about; or the water churns away from the tube.

pc.expect: One glass and one tube keep their number.
pc.fail: The glass duplicates; or the tube vanishes; or foam appears away from the glass.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The glass, the pump and the background stay the same.
pc.fail: The water changes colour; or the glass changes shape; or the background rearranges.
